occurrences.bsb: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
occurrences.kjv: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

occurrences.bsb: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

occurrences.bsb: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
occurrences.kjv: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

occurrences.bsb: Then Moses presented Aaron’s sons, put tunics on them, wrapped sashes around them, and tied headbands on them, just as the LORD had commanded him.
occurrences.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the Lord commanded Moses.
